name: Grace Wu
bio: Grace Wu 吴晓恩 is a New York based actress born in Changchun (长春), China. In 2016, she immigrated to the US at the age of 15. She is known for Get Wrong, Get Right (2024), Can’t Be Cancelled (2023),  Divoc-91 (2023), Becky and Francis are in Deep $#!+ (2023). Shot in her hometown and a story close to her heart, Lulu Wang's “The Farewell" inspires her in nuanced storytelling of an immigrant experience. She is grateful to her Nai Nai (奶奶) for her love and guidance.
